'''Coral Collegium''' was a school on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], a [[Planet/Legends|world]] where education was highly valued. The [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Tendaar Bel]] was enrolled in [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysics]] classes there, although he never actually attended the curriculum. He was there until the [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari]]<ref name="Tendaar" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> when he was put to work in the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]].<ref name="Tendaar" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Collegium is mentioned in Tendaar Bel's Character Folio, which is included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
